scope.inclusion_rule: All non-hidden regular files returned by rg --files for the three formalization roots plus the six exact cross-package files listed in exact_paths.

aggregate.canonicalization: LC_ALL=C sorted paths, GNU sha256sum row per path, then SHA-256 of the complete row stream
aggregate.command: rg --files projects/domainspec-v2/formalization projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/src/formalization projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/test/formalization projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/src/cli/main.ts projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/package.json projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/test/contract/package-boundary.test.mjs projects/domainspec-v2/definitions/meta-types/meta-types.yml projects/domainspec-v2/definitions/relationships/relationships.yml projects/domainspec-v2/development/meta-type-implementation-depth/implementation-layering.md | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum

claim_limit: This freezes one candidate byte set and its validation results. It does not admit semantic preservation, implementation conformance, publication, release, deployment, or production.
